title: Checklist Template File v1
description: A reusable checklist/form template for Business Online Template Manager. The file is the bare fields array — the template's name, code, category, and applicable project types are entered by the user in Template Manager at import time and are NOT part of this file.

name.description: Internal name derived from displayName: lowercased, whitespace runs replaced by '_'. Other characters (?, /, parentheses, Norwegian å/ø/æ) are preserved.

displayName.description: Human-readable question/label shown to the person filling in the checklist.

section.description: Section header that groups consecutive fields. The checklist equivalent of a page/fieldset.

type.description: Field input type. choice/multichoice require 'values'. multiline may set 'rows'. number may set 'min'/'max'. attachment is a standalone upload field. peoplepicker selects a person.

order.description: Global 1-based display order across the whole form (not per-section). Should be unique.

placeholder.description: Hint text. Available on all field types.

defaultValue.description: Default value, stored as a string for all types (e.g. "0" for a number). Available on all field types.

allowAttachment.description: When true, the person filling in the checklist may attach a file/photo to their answer. Distinct from the standalone 'attachment' field type.

replicate.description: When true, the field may be repeated by the user (e.g. one entry per location or per workstation).

values.description: Allowed options for choice/multichoice fields, in display order.

rows.description: Visible row count for a multiline text field.

min.description: Minimum accepted value for a number field.

max.description: Maximum accepted value for a number field.

links.description: Reference links shown alongside the field — external web pages or governing documents.

url.description: External web URL. Empty string when this link is a governing document referenced via fileUrl.

fileUrl.description: Governing-document reference (a *.sharepoint.com/sites/*/GoverningDocumentLibrary/ URL). Empty string for external links.
